title: Distilling Directional Verification
abstract: arXiv:2610.00997v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Knowledge distillation aims to transfer the factual knowledge of large language models to smaller models for efficient deployment. Yet a teacher may recall a relation in one direction while failing to generate the answer in the reverse direction. Distillation from its generated answers can therefore propagate this directional limitation to the student. The same teacher can nevertheless recognize such an answer by scoring the relation in the direction it knows. We introduce directional label distillation, in which frozen teachers score candidate answers in that known direction and the best-scoring candidate becomes the student's training target. On facts about parents and their children, known-direction scoring yields more accurate labels than scoring the requested direction, even after tuned corrections for name priors. With prior-corrected scores, the better direction depends on the facts rather than the template, and reverses on mine

translated_abstract: 知识蒸馏旨在将大型语言模型的事实知识迁移到较小的模型中，以实现高效部署。然而，教师模型可能只在某个方向上能够回忆起某种关系，却无法在反方向上生成答案。因此，基于其生成的答案进行蒸馏，会将这种方向性局限传播给学生模型。不过，同一个教师模型可以通过在其已知方向上对该关系进行评分，来识别出这样的答案。我们提出了方向性标签蒸馏方法，其中冻结的教师模型在其已知方向上对候选答案进行评分，得分最高的候选答案成为学生模型的训练目标。在关于父母与其子女的事实上，已知方向的评分比按请求方向的评分能产生更准确的标签，即使在对名字先验进行了调优校正之后也是如此。在使用先验校正后的分数时，哪个方向更优取决于具体事实而非模板，并且在……上会发生反转（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出方向性标签蒸馏方法：让冻结的教师模型在其已知的知识方向上对候选答案进行评分，并将得分最高的候选答案作为学生模型的训练目标，从而避免将教师模型的单向知识局限传播给学生模型。
en_tdlr: Proposes directional label distillation, in which a frozen teacher scores candidate answers in the direction it knows and the best-scoring candidate becomes the student's training target, thereby avoiding propagating the teacher's directional knowledge limitations to the student.
